title: Task Board carousel directional gesture lock
description: Keeps the Task Board page scroll from activating during a horizontal phase carousel swipe. Layout/padding/title remain unchanged.
qaExpectedBehavior: Vertical page scroll works normally outside the carousel.
Horizontal swipe inside the phase carousel locks parent ListView scroll only after horizontal intent is detected.
No title movement, no card translateY, no page padding change.
On pointer up/cancel, parent vertical scroll is released after the snap delay.
